name: What factors affect the cost of bathroom storage improvements?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the cost of bathroom storage improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of bathroom storage improvements depends on cabinet construction type, materials, and whether framing or plumbing must be altered. Minor upgrades like swapping standard mirrors for recessed cabinets or adding simple open shelving remain on the lower end of remodeling budgets. Extensive updates, such as custom vanity installations with specialty pullouts, dedicated floor-to-ceiling linen towers, and custom tiled niches, require skilled carpentry, framing, and finish work. Costs also increase if existing supply lines, vents, or electrical runs inside the targeted wall cavities must be relocated to accommodate recessed storage units.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs are determined by custom versus stock cabinetry, material selections, and whether plumbing, electrical, or structural framing must be moved inside the walls.
